subject.title: fix: derived caches wedge cloud-worker reconciliation and reclaim

question: Should cloud-worker reconciliation permanently treat `node_modules`, the listed tool caches, `.DS_Store`, and all `.pyc`/`.pyo` paths as non-transferable derived output for existing sessions?
rationale: This deliberately changes which previously synchronized workspace paths are preserved, so the correct fixed exclusion boundary is a product and compatibility choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the fixed exclusion boundary

options.title: Narrow the exclusion set
options.body: Exclude only confirmed cache classes and retain synchronization for any path class maintainers consider legitimate workspace output.
